tools.name: consentio_overview
tools.description: What Consentio is, its plans and how to get started. Call this first when the user wants a cookie banner / GDPR consent / Google Consent Mode v2 on a website and has no Consentio account yet.

tools.name: get_install_snippet
tools.description: Returns the exact <script> snippet to install the Consentio cookie banner for a site key, plus the install guide URL for the platform. Does not need an API key.

tools.name: scan_cookies
tools.description: Scans a public website for trackers and cookies (analytics, marketing, preferences) that need consent. Does not need an API key. Rate limited per IP.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the user's Consentio sites with install status and health. Requires an API key (Free keys work).

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Creates a site in the user's account and returns its site key and the install snippet. Respects the plan's site limit (Free: 1 site). Requires an API key (Free keys work).

tools.name: check_install
tools.description: Re-checks whether the Consentio snippet is installed on a site (fetches the page and matches the site key). Requires an API key (Free keys work).

tools.name: get_site_health
tools.description: Health level, score and uptime of a site. Requires an API key (Free keys work).

tools.name: list_consents
tools.description: Recent consent records of a site (sandbox/test consents excluded). Requires a Pro or Agency API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "consentio_overview" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
